title: Power Rankings: Bulls finish on top
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 24
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Every Bulls team that's ever won 60 games has gone on to win it all. So the least we can say about this one, however inexperienced, is that the sixth 60-win team in franchise history is the favorite in the East. Right?
